title: LoxyCraft
description: A lightweight utility mod adding compressed blocks, custom utility components, and small vanilla quality-of-life recipes.
body:
LoxyCraft is a personal utility mod focused on compressed blocks, useful crafting components, and small vanilla quality-of-life additions.

The mod adds a full compressed block system from x1 to x9 for many common resources and building blocks, making large storage setups cleaner and easier to manage. It also adds a few custom utility blocks and components intended to support future Loxy mods and personal gameplay needs.

LoxyCraft is designed to stay lightweight, practical, and simple: no complex progression system, no heavy gameplay overhaul, just useful blocks, recipes, and components that fit naturally into Minecraft.
